subject: Auto-drain tested approvals, keep ready work spawning, and drop stale bench smoke gate
description: Fix the orchestrator automation gap observed on 2026-06-24: tasks reach tested/reviewed states but do not reliably merge/promote to done, while ready work piles up with 0 in_progress until the user manually drives next_action. Also retire the stale default `python3 bench/zonoid_bench/smoke.py` gate from routine task completion/review so tasks that pass targeted tests are not KICK_BACK/requeued solely because Claude smoke times out. Success criteria: (1) tested tasks with review_verdict APPROVE/review_state approved and merge_state pending automatically call the normal no-force merge path and become done when merge succeeds; (2) tasks with merge_state merged but status tested are promoted to done automatically; (3) conflicts or blocked merges stay visible and are not force-merged; (4) the ready frontier loop keeps spawning returned ready tasks without requiring user prompts, within existing loop budget/concurrency rules; (5) tests cover pending->merged->done, already-merged->done cleanup, conflict/no-force behavior, and stale smoke gate not blocking targeted-pass tasks.

summary: Implemented headless review-merge finalization for approved tested tasks, kept merge conflicts visible, kept leased ready work polling instead of stopping the loop, and filtered the stale python3 bench/zonoid_bench/smoke.py command from routine test_cmd gating. Commit 346da25bd. Tests: node --test test/headless-drain.test.js; node test/spawn-lease.test.js; node test/test-cmd.test.js; node test/review-lifecycle.test.js; node --test test/graph-loop-owner.test.js; git diff --check.
